reviewer_notes.scope: One synthetic, developer-inspected example; not a held-out benchmark or fluent-speaker validation.
observed_success: Two arrival communication complaints grouped with two source quotes.
Broken sign routed to business decision rather than communication practice.
Generated practice opening asks which gate to use; exercise facts preserved.
observed_failures: Repair request mislabeled positive, causing a false different-views label.
First translation narrows coffee tasting to coffee flavor; translation fidelity still imperfect.
reviewer_notes.subsequent_guard: Positive polarity with improve/practice now marks the review uncertain. Different views requires opposite positive/negative sentiment from different, non-uncertain source texts. Covered by regression tests; raw output above predates that guard.
